_note: Client facts an FAQ answer can rest on (FAQ sorting step, faq-sort.js). A question that needs one of these is held back until the client has supplied it. 'supplied' says when a value counts as given: filled (not blank), yes (the value is yes), answered (any answer), guarantee (guarantee_years above 0 or a manufacturer warranty). Working practices (niche-library/practices.json) are facts too, supplied when ticked in confirmed_practices. 'question' is the onboarding form question. The three marked new were added 14 Oct 2026 (Brandon's decision: they come up for every trade).

facts.label: Insurance cover
facts.question: What public liability insurance do you hold, and for how much?

facts.label: Guarantee
facts.question: Do you guarantee your work? For how many years, and does a manufacturer warranty apply?

facts.label: What the guarantee covers
facts.question: What does your guarantee cover (for example new work and repairs), and for how long each?

facts.label: Free quotes
facts.question: Are your quotes free?

facts.label: Free inspection or first visit
facts.question: Do you charge for an inspection, survey or first visit?

facts.label: How quotes are given
facts.question: How do you give quotes (visit, photos, call), and how soon does the customer get one?

facts.label: What the quote includes
facts.question: What does your quote include? For example materials, labour, VAT, skips, waste removal, scaffolding or access equipment.

facts.label: Deposit and stage payments
facts.question: Do you take a deposit? If so, how much, and when are any stage payments and the final payment due?

facts.label: Registered waste carrier
facts.question: Are you registered as a waste carrier? (yes or no)

facts.label: Price list
facts.question: Do you publish a price list? If so, where?

facts.label: Typical jobs with from prices and durations
facts.question: For 3 typical jobs, what is your from price and how long does each usually take?

facts.label: How soon work can start
facts.question: How soon can you usually start a job?

facts.label: Response time
facts.question: How quickly do you reply to an enquiry or call back?

facts.label: Same day visits
facts.question: Can you come out the same day?

facts.label: Out of hours work
facts.question: Do you work out of hours or 24/7, and is there a surcharge?

facts.label: How far you travel
facts.question: How far do you travel for work?

facts.label: Handles planning permission
facts.question: Do you handle planning permission or building control for the customer?

facts.label: Finance options
facts.question: Do you offer finance or payment plans?

facts.label: What happens if something goes wrong
facts.question: If a customer isn't happy with the work, what do you do?

facts.label: Team size
facts.question: How many people work in your team, and who does the work on site?

facts.label: Materials and methods used
facts.question: Which materials and methods do you use?

facts.label: Qualifications
facts.question: What qualifications do you or your team hold?

facts.label: Jobs completed
facts.question: Roughly how many jobs have you completed?
